findings.title: Retain repair completion when cancellation arrives after commit
findings.trigger: An accepted repair commits on the worker before the 30ms UI timer consumes its completion, then the user presses Cancel while the phase is still 1.
findings.impact: The callback drops the receiver and unconditionally displays Cancelled!, discarding a successful durable completion and skipping changed(), which is wired to MainWindow refresh_page. The documented closing-after-commit limitation does not justify inaccurate cancel status or omitted refresh.
findings.recommendation: Request cancellation while retaining the repair receiver. Consume the authoritative result, refresh and report completion on success, and report cancellation only when the worker returns cancellation. Add a deterministic regression that waits for committed store timestamps without pumping UI timers before cancelling.
findings.root_response: Root acknowledged and is implementing this repair plus pre-write cancellation coverage.
findings.resolution: Current uncommitted repair retains receiver while repairing, requests cancellation, and lets authoritative Completed::Repaired result drive status/refresh. New deterministic test covers cancellation before write and after durable commit without pumping timers. Source fix accepted; execution pending.
